purpose: Tenth-pass official and first-party verification for five existing Batch-51 rows while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable. No second task, runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction notices, first-party operator pages, Companies House, Charity Commission, local-authority, school and Food Standards Agency records are promoted. Current operation or an exact address does not alone prove lease assignment, legal completion or parcel geometry.
method.entity_reconciliation_policy: Where the primary auction source states a charity or company number, that identifier controls over a similarly named but legally distinct entity.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.

rows.address: 15 High Street, Earls Colne, Essex, CO6 2PA
rows.resolved_fact: Earls Colne Primary School's current uniform page identifies It Takes a Village at the exact 15 High Street address with published opening hours. Companies House records FOUR COLNES - IT TAKES A VILLAGE C.I.C. as active with second-hand-goods retail SIC 47799. Together with Acuitus' correction that the title address is 15 High Street and the Co-op head lease expires on 27 July 2027, this strongly identifies a current exact-address occupier candidate, but the executed sublease, licence or concession linking the CIC to the head lease was not read.

rows.address: Lloyds Chambers, The Square, Barnstaple, Devon, EX32 8LS
rows.resolved_fact: A current first-party Scoff's Barnstaple website is live. Companies House records D SCOFF'S LTD as an active food-service company and its controlling-person record uses 1 The Square, Barnstaple, EX32 8LS. This materially strengthens the current Scoff's operating-company route after SCOFFS ORIGINAL LIMITED was dissolved, but the public records still do not prove the exact restaurant demise within Lloyds Chambers or an assignment or replacement of the auction lease.

Highbrow London's current first-party site and booking route identify a beauty and aesthetics clinic at 3 Station Approach. A separate current first-party Shepperton Minicabs page also identifies No.3 Station Approach as its contact address. The auction property is described as 3/3A, so both routes may relate to separate parts or one may be stale, but the public evidence does not allocate the operators to the exact demise or prove the conditional beauty lease and planning consent.

rows.address: 14-18 High Street, Heathfield, East Sussex, TN21 8LS
rows.resolved_fact: The Food Standards Agency records The Original Factory Shop as a regulated retail establishment at the exact 14-18 High Street address, but its inspection is dated 19 November 2021 and is historical rather than proof of current trading. Companies House continues to record THE FACTORY SHOP LIMITED in administration and the primary auction page identifies the same exact property and lapsed planning reference. Exact site identity is reinforced, while current operation after administration remains unverified.

Acuitus explicitly identifies the tenant as CHARIS (Christian Help & Action for Refugees in Somerset), charity number 1169400, under a five-year lease from 8 June 2022. Somerset Council currently lists CHARIS Refugees' Welcome Hub at the exact 16/17 Hammet Street address and the Charity Commission records the same charity number at that address. The prior comparison with CHARIS GRANTS LIMITED company 04762902 was therefore a wrong-entity match: the auction tenant and current exact occupier are the same charity. The executed lease, any break notice after year three, Land Registry completion and exact title geometry remain unread.
